own_solution.law: For isolated mixing of ideal gases initially at equal temperature and pressure, temperature remains constant and V_i/V = n_i/(n_1+n_2). Therefore ΔS = R[n_1 ln((n_1+n_2)/n_1) + n_2 ln((n_1+n_2)/n_2)].
assumptions: The target is the entropy change during mixing, after any gas addition and equilibration.
The gases are ideal and nonreacting, as stated.
The thin partition has negligible energy and entropy contributions.
